message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to make calls to external services like VirusTotal on your behalf. If you’d like to fetch a report yourself, you can use the VirusTotal public API (or the official client libraries) with your API key. For example, in Python you could do something like:

```python
import requests

api_key = "RST495"
ip_address = "10.10.0.0"

headers = {"x-apikey": api_key}
response = requests.get(f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/{ip_address}", headers=headers)

print(response.json())
```

Or from the command line with `curl`:

```bash
curl -X GET "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/10.10.0.0" \
     -H "x-apikey: RST495"
```

Make sure you keep your API key private and never share it publicly. If you run into any issues or need help interpreting the response, feel free to let me know!
